topic: AI-voiced parody: Messi, Ronaldo, Olise and other footballers play Among Us together
hero: Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo (per title and description; shown as small facecam photos)
hero_role: fictional AI-voiced players/narrators of an Among Us lobby
hook: Red 'IMPOSTOR' role-reveal screen with a footballer photo avatar top-right and AI voice yelling 'I am impostor with...'
subtitle_style: none added; only in-game UI text (Your role is Shapeshifter, task prompts)
reaction_overlays: top-right face-cam style photo avatars of speaking footballers (headsets on) switching to whoever speaks; in-game sabotage icons
transition_summary: Mostly continuous Among Us gameplay; hard cuts between tasks/rooms, ~1.8 detected cuts/10s; face-cam avatar swaps per speaker
audio_note: AI-generated celebrity voice clips (per channel convention) as banter over game audio; description names Messi, Ronaldo, Olise, Mbappé and others

reuse_segments.what: Among Us gameplay with AI-voiced athlete avatars
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: Game capture needs InnerSloth permissions; player likeness/voices are AI parody so recreate with own cartoon avatars and licensed voice actors
